caption: One 1000 MIPS VM runs the five cloudlets shortest first: C4 (2000 MI) takes 2 s, then C2, C5 and C3, and C1 (10000 MI) ends at 31 s. Bars touch, so the last finish is the makespan, and the five waits average 8.6 s.

spec.aria: A timeline of one 1000 MIPS VM running five cloudlets in shortest-job-first order: C4 from 0 to 2 s, C2 from 2 to 7 s, C5 from 7 to 13 s, C3 from 13 to 21 s, and C1 from 21 to 31 s.
